items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: "Mambo a la Savoy" with Walter Fuller.

ctx.x: Uh huh. All right. I know that you wrote a lot of tunes there. What was the other tunes that you composed in that apartment, at 111th Street, near Second Avenue?
Ahh, "Mambo a la Savoy" with Walter Fuller. "Yo tengo un ate", "Te lo dije my Friend", "I like the Puerto Rican Way" and -----
About how many tunes have you composed, Macho?
